upstream_status.dispute_points: (1) Window is tiny in practice: thread 0 must run a global-load-heavy loop (reads dataset[old*3], k-loop) before it hits the L67 store while the other warps only need one LDS, so no wrong output has ever been observed; a skeptic will say it is a benign latent race.
